description: Synthetic fixture B -- an unrelated business document type (NDA, not invoice-like). Used alongside fixture A to prove the connector generalizes across document shapes rather than being hard-coded to one demo case.
document_html:
Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

This Agreement is entered into between Bluepeak Systems ("Disclosing Party") and Cratrock Labs ("Receiving Party").

1. Confidential Information

Confidential Information means any non-public business, technical, or financial information disclosed by either party.

2. Term

This Agreement remains in effect for two (2) years from the Effective Date.
